P: Serve the mains when Roy sculpts the mashed potatoes at dinner.

the family dinner that goes off the rails

Dry-brined chicken with thyme butter under the skin, roasted golden and crisp, with buttered peas and carrots and a simple pan gravy. Salt a 1.8kg chicken all over and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Mash 50g soft butter with thyme leaves and push it under the breast skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Boil 4 sliced carrots for 6 minutes and 300g frozen peas for 3, then toss in butter.
W: Chocolate cake stacked tall, covered in chocolate buttercream with vertical ridges dragged in with a fork.
K: Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup blended with ripe strawberries, topped up with chilled water in a big jug over ice with mint. Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with 120ml sugar syrup until smooth and strain into a large jug. Stir in 150ml fresh lemon juice and 700ml cold water. Add plenty of ice, sliced strawberries and lemon wheels. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a mint sprig.

s.how: Whisk 3 egg whites and 180g sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks. Pipe into flat saucer shapes with a small dome in the middle. Bake at 100C for 90 minutes and cool. Spread a dot of lemon curd underneath.

Lay out 20 seeded crackers in rows of five. Top each row with a different note: 80g cream cheese, 80g chicken liver pâté, 80g sliced cheddar, 100g smoked salmon with dill, and 4 halved fresh or dried figs. Serve straight away so the crackers stay crisp.

m.note: sculpt it like Roy, gravy runs down the sides
m.how: Boil 1.5kg floury potatoes, rice them and beat with 200ml hot milk and 100g butter. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter, stir in a tablespoon of flour and add 400ml beef stock. Pile the mash into a tall mountain and pour gravy over.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in three small tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Stack tall with buttercream of 200g butter, 350g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, then drag ridges with a fork.

d.how: Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with 120ml sugar syrup until smooth and strain into a large jug. Stir in 150ml fresh lemon juice and 700ml cold water. Add plenty of ice, sliced strawberries and lemon wheels. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a mint sprig.
